reasonEN: An easy greedy array problem. Comparing endpoints against differing colors trains extremal-pair reasoning.
reasonZH: 这是一道简单贪心数组题。用端点比较不同颜色，训练极值配对思维。

reasonEN: A medium counting and enumeration problem. Aggregating two-letter patterns trains concise case analysis over character frequencies.
reasonZH: 这是一道中等计数枚举题。聚合双字母模式，训练基于字符频次的分类讨论。

reasonEN: An easy membership-counting problem. Recording each value's source arrays with sets or bitmasks teaches compact presence tracking.
reasonZH: 这是一道简单成员计数题。用集合或位掩码记录来源数组，训练紧凑的出现状态维护。

reasonEN: The foundational easy hash-table problem. Looking up complements before storing the current value establishes a core linear-time pairing pattern.
reasonZH: 这是基础的简单哈希表题。先查补数再存当前值，建立线性时间配对的核心模式。

reasonEN: A medium sorted-array two-pointer template. Moving boundaries by sum comparison demonstrates how ordering removes unnecessary searches.
reasonZH: 这是一道中等有序数组双指针模板题。依据和移动边界，训练如何利用有序性消除无效搜索。

reasonEN: An easy tree two-sum problem. Traversing while tracking seen values connects standard hash matching with tree exploration.
reasonZH: 这是一道简单树上两数之和题。遍历时维护已见值，将哈希匹配与树搜索结合。

reasonEN: An easy math classification problem. Sorting sides before checking inequalities and equalities trains orderly geometric validation.
reasonZH: 这是一道简单数学分类题。先排序边长再检查不等式与相等关系，训练有序的几何校验。

reasonEN: An easy greedy selection problem. Sorting candidates and respecting parity constraints teaches constrained choice under simple ordering.
reasonZH: 这是一道简单贪心选择题。排序候选并满足奇偶限制，训练简单有序约束下的取舍。

reasonEN: A medium backtracking combination template. Controlling the next start index prevents duplicates and builds systematic subset generation.
reasonZH: 这是一道中等回溯组合模板题。控制下一起点避免重复，训练系统化子集生成。

reasonEN: An easy number-theory reduction problem. Repeatedly dividing allowed prime factors trains factorization-based validation.
reasonZH: 这是一道简单数论约简题。反复除以允许的质因数，训练基于分解的有效性判断。

reasonEN: A medium DP sequence-generation problem. Advancing multiple prime pointers while deduplicating values teaches merge-style state maintenance.
reasonZH: 这是一道中等 DP 序列生成题。推进多个质因数指针并去重，训练归并式状态维护。

reasonEN: A medium number-theory answer-search problem. Binary search with inclusion-exclusion counting trains monotone feasibility design.
reasonZH: 这是一道中等数论答案二分题。用容斥计数构造单调判定，训练可行性设计。

reasonEN: An easy string frequency problem. Tokenizing both sentences into one count map reinforces normalization before filtering.
reasonZH: 这是一道简单字符串频次题。将两句分词并汇总到计数表，训练过滤前的规范化处理。

reasonEN: A medium sequence DP problem equivalent to longest common subsequence. Matching or skipping endpoints trains the classic two-dimensional recurrence.
reasonZH: 这是一道等价于最长公共子序列的中等序列 DP 题。匹配或跳过端点，训练经典二维递推。

reasonEN: An easy enumeration problem with digit constraints. Building candidates without reuse and deduplicating results trains constrained generation.
reasonZH: 这是一道带数字约束的简单枚举题。无重复构造候选并去重，训练受限生成。

reasonEN: A medium Catalan-number DP problem. Splitting by root and multiplying left-right counts trains recursive combinatorial decomposition.
reasonZH: 这是一道中等卡特兰数 DP 题。按根节点拆分并相乘左右数量，训练递归组合分解。

reasonEN: A medium tree-construction problem. Combining every left and right subtree for each root trains recursive generation with structural sharing awareness.
reasonZH: 这是一道中等树构造题。为每个根组合左右子树，训练递归生成与结构组合。

reasonEN: An easy normalization and hash-set problem. Applying local-part rules before insertion teaches canonical representation for deduplication.
reasonZH: 这是一道简单规范化哈希集合题。按本地部分规则处理后再插入，训练去重中的标准表示。

reasonEN: A medium string counting problem. Fixing outer characters and counting distinct middle values trains endpoint-based subsequence enumeration.
reasonZH: 这是一道中等字符串计数题。固定两端字符并统计不同中间值，训练基于端点的子序列枚举。

reasonEN: An easy encoding and set problem. Transforming each word and collecting signatures reinforces representation mapping and deduplication.
reasonZH: 这是一道简单编码集合题。转换每个单词并收集签名，巩固表示映射与去重。

reasonEN: An easy two-level hash-table check. Counting values then verifying frequency uniqueness trains composed set-based validation.
reasonZH: 这是一道简单双层哈希检查题。先统计值再验证频次唯一，训练组合式集合校验。

reasonEN: A medium grid DP and combinatorics template. Accumulating paths from top and left teaches additive path-counting structure.
reasonZH: 这是一道中等网格 DP 与组合模板题。累加上方和左方路径，训练加法型路径计数结构。

reasonEN: A medium obstacle-grid DP problem. Resetting blocked cells while preserving reachable counts trains robust boundary-aware transitions.
reasonZH: 这是一道中等障碍网格 DP 题。遇到障碍清零并保留可达计数，训练边界感知转移。

reasonEN: A hard grid backtracking problem. Tracking visited cells and requiring full coverage before the target trains exhaustive state restoration.
reasonZH: 这是一道困难网格回溯题。追踪访问单元并要求到终点前全覆盖，训练完整的状态恢复。

reasonEN: A medium string DP problem. Keeping the longest valid ending length per character avoids duplicate substring counts.
reasonZH: 这是一道中等字符串 DP 题。维护每个字符结尾的最长合法长度，避免重复子串计数。

reasonEN: A medium graph traversal problem. Propagating conversion ratios through BFS or DFS trains weighted relation resolution.
reasonZH: 这是一道中等图遍历题。通过 BFS 或 DFS 传播转换比例，训练带权关系求解。

reasonEN: An easy tree traversal validation. Comparing every node to the root value builds a clean recursive predicate pattern.
reasonZH: 这是一道简单树遍历校验题。将每个节点与根值比较，训练简洁的递归谓词模式。

reasonEN: A medium graph reconstruction problem. Topological sorting with uniqueness checks trains dependency validation beyond merely finding an order.
reasonZH: 这是一道中等图重建题。拓扑排序中检查唯一性，训练不止寻找顺序的依赖验证。

reasonEN: An easy SQL aggregation problem. Filtering the date range before counting distinct users trains time-window reporting.
reasonZH: 这是一道简单 SQL 聚合题。先筛选日期范围再统计活跃用户，训练时间窗口报表。

reasonEN: A medium greedy stack problem. Releasing buffered characters only when no smaller suffix remains trains lexicographic decision invariants.
reasonZH: 这是一道中等贪心栈题。仅在后缀不再有更小字符时输出缓冲字符，训练字典序决策不变量。
